items.title: Paquito D'Rivera — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I wrote the piece called “Hello to Stano;” and it was a piece dedicated to Stano

ctx.x: Give me an idea of whose music you had the band playing and what tunes you had the band playing.

Wow, that happened so many years ago. I wrote the piece called “Hello to Stano;” and it was a piece dedicated to Stano, for alto, tenor, and big band, that was one piece. Some other pieces by Chucho Valdés, wonderful Afro-Cuban type instrumental music by Chuchos Valdés um, and some arrangements from Armando Romeu that in those days he got a couple of them when they have a big band in the village. That type of music, and some European friends that send me charts, also from Finland, from Sweden, so that was Jazz…
What kind of gigs did your orchestra play?
